hardwareHubs.note: mHUB is a hardtech innovation center on a 2-acre site on the near west side with prototyping labs and a micro-factory.
The University of Illinois Research Park hosts the EnterpriseWorks incubator at 60 Hazelwood Drive.

makerspaces.name: Workshop 88
makerspaces.note: Lists laser cutting and engraving, a Shapeoko CNC, a CNC mill, several 3D printers and an electronics lab with SMD PCB fabrication.

makerspaces.name: Pumping Station: One
makerspaces.note: Volunteer-run space at 3519 N. Elston Ave. whose site mentions an electronics lab and links a tools page that was not readable.

events.name: Maker Faire Lake County
events.note: Free faire hosted by the College of Lake County, with the 2026 edition held on April 18.

programs.name: mHUB
programs.note: Runs an accelerator with energy tech, MedTech and sustainable manufacturing tracks plus access to prototyping labs and mentors.

programs.name: EnterpriseWorks
programs.note: University of Illinois Research Park incubator that lists wet labs, offices and an entrepreneur-in-residence team.

specialties.name: Food processing
specialties.note: A state-promotional article calls the Illinois food processing cluster the second largest in the country, with more than 2,100 facilities.

specialties.name: Aerospace and defense
specialties.note: The same article reports nearly 19,000 companies and about 236,000 workers in aerospace and defense.

specialties.name: Automotive
specialties.note: The same article reports the fifth-largest automotive employer ecosystem in the U.S.

specialties.name: Advanced manufacturing
specialties.note: The same article reports more than 582,700 manufacturing workers, a concentration 18 percent above the national average.

support.name: Illinois Manufacturing Excellence Center (IMEC)
support.note: Not-for-profit funded in part by NIST MEP that offers consulting, training and supply chain help to manufacturers.
